crossRefs.note: The Jews accepted the custom that they had begun, as Mordecai had written to them;

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: The Jews accepted the custom that they had begun, as Mordecai had written to them;
translations.bsb: So the Jews agreed to continue the custom they had started, as Mordecai had written to them.
translations.kjv: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written
translations.asv: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;
